name: Identity Binding
description: Scoped evidence-based assessment. Display order is not an assurance threshold. Apply to an explicit subject and comparison scope; the value alone grants no authority.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: Evaluation could not establish the requested claim in the stated scope.

values.label: Observed
values.description: Identity obtained through a named local observation interface.

values.label: Enrolled key
values.description: Accepted enrollment and fresh possession proof bind the exact key to the subject.

values.label: Attested key
values.description: Accepted device or workload attestation and fresh possession proof bind the exact key to the subject.
